correctness.rationale: Only diameter maximizers for any fixed subhemispherical lune are ordered polar pairs. The sharp cone-sum coercivity localizes endpoints to order epsilon, and a four-dimensional area Jacobian yields a cone-convolution volume explicitly evaluated by elementary integration. The independent critical-window Fermi-coordinate reduction has a three-dimensional volume with a clear compact-uniform dominated-convergence argument; its integral yields the hemisphere coefficient and far-window matching. A reproducible checker from its actual package path passed 20 tests. No numerical finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
